items.description: Pipe repair – replacement section, sealing, rock-wool insulation
items.rationale: Escape of water from the supply pipe is covered (2.4.2/2.4.3). A like-for-like section with sealing and insulation falls under 7.1.7(c). Priced from the Case 39 materials (pipe, sealing, insulation, fittings).

Labour of the engaged trade at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g). A flat rate for opening, repairing and supporting over a couple of visits is estimated between the hourly prior and Case 39's much larger labour totals.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f), and this is the only one on the invoice. The price prior is about 81.
Drying before closing the wall is covered under 7.1.7(b), and one flat-rate equipment deployment per drying operation under 7.1.7(e). Case 39 proved at least 403; the prior is about 439.

items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening needed to reach the pipe is covered under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected patch. Case 39 proved at least 416; the prior is about 453.
